author: volunteer state news
title: CUSA announces revised 2026 football schedule
text:
Conference USA announced on Apr. 29 a revised football schedule for the 2026 season following the departure of Louisiana Tech. The changes affect all teams in the conference, with Jacksonville State replacing Louisiana Tech on Middle Tennessee State University’s (MTSU) schedule.
The updated schedule is important as it maintains competitive balance and ensures each team has a full slate of games despite recent conference realignment. For MTSU, this will be its 112th football season and third under Head Coach Derek Mason.
According to Conference USA, the Blue Raiders will play six home games and three mid-week contests as part of “Weekday CUSA.” Their non-conference lineup includes a first-time matchup against Kansas. Home opponents are Murray State, Nevada, Delaware, Kennesaw State (the defending CUSA champion), Western Kentucky University (WKU), and New Mexico State. Road games include matchups at Marshall, Jacksonville State, Kansas, Florida International University (FIU), Liberty, and Sam Houston.
Season tickets for Blue Raider Football are now available through GoBlueRaiders.com/tickets. Fans can select from Chair Back Reserved Seats ($150 per seat), Sideline Reserved Seats ($135 per seat), or End Zone Reserved Seats ($110 per seat). Premium seating options are also offered in two exclusive game-day clubs: the Jeff Hendrix Stadium Club and the SRM Concrete Club—opened in fall of 2025—as well as open-air boxes that include ten season tickets for group purchases. Additional information is available by contacting the Blue Raider Ticket Office.
Season ticket holders receive several benefits such as a discount at Lightning’s Locker Room on game days, an $11 concession stand bundle including a hot dog, popcorn, and drink; trade-in opportunities for unused tickets; monetary savings compared to single-game pricing; early access to single-game sales; priority access to away game tickets; priority for post-season bowl game seats; and reserved seating not typically available for single-game sales.
Fans who held season tickets previously have until May 31 to renew their commitment for the upcoming year with various payment plans available—including up to four monthly installments beginning May 16 through August 16.
